description:
Wish you could open a fresh chat and pick up where you left off? With ContinueVault, you finally can. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your vault so it can go get the details, decisions, even files it needs. Our Chrome extension keeps that vault up to date with chats from the AI accounts you choose.

Continue chats even from most other AI platforms right in your fresh ChatGPT chats.

Those buried details from past conversations? ChatGPT does the digging for you. Files you shared or your AI created? It can bring those in too. The actual conversations and files stay available to your fresh sessions, whenever you need to go back.

Feel what it’s like when your AI can find what you need and recover what you worked out together, as you work, right inside the chat.

Portable AI memory? This is continuity. Continuity of the work you’ve already done with AI.
